svg.title: Peyton. I build the software I use every day.
svg.desc: A transit strip map. One red line runs through three stations: Decide (what gets built), Check (with my own eyes), Ship it (my call), then a stretch where every test runs in a fresh VM, ending at Live. Between Decide and Check, six thin tracks fan out and rejoin: the agents build it.
svg.text: I build the software I use every day.
every test, in a fresh VM
